verdict.rationale: Ramp's own materials claim receipts are captured automatically at the moment of card swipe, with AI-filled memos and categories. They also describe automatic transaction categorization that learns from history and team feedback and syncs coded transactions to the ERP, plus an auto-coding agent. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how receipt capture works at swipe time (channels, matching accuracy, fallbacks), and independent or hands-on corroboration of automatic receipt capture and coding.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have receipts automatically captured and coded the moment a card is used, without manual entry

citations.quote: Auto-receipt capture at the moment of card swipe with AI-filled memos and categories
Ramp automatically categorizes transactions based on transaction details, historical information, and your team's direct feedback, then syncs coded transactions directly to your ERP.
Four AI agents handle auto-coding, fraud prevention, approval routing, and automatic payment
Ramp automates each step, from collecting receipts to drafting memos.
